title: Pat and Tap
lines: Pat the mat, Sam! Pat, pat, pat!
Tap the mat, Pam! Tap, tap!
Pat and tap! Pat and tap!
Tam sat at the mat. I am Tam!
Pat, Tam! Tap, Tam! Pat and tap!
Sam and Pam and Tam tap and tap.

questions.ask: Who sat at the mat first?
questions.listenFor: Sam. It is the very first line. If your child is not sure, put a finger on that line and let them read it again rather than telling them.

questions.ask: Who came to the mat last?
questions.listenFor: Tam. Line six says it. A one word answer is a fine answer here.

questions.ask: What would you tap to make a good sound? Tell me why that one.
questions.listenFor: Any answer is a good answer. You are listening for a reason of their own, and it is a lovely excuse to go and tap on something together.
